description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon/rules/central_D_lon_periodic driven by problems/latlon_advection_zonal_periodic.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NLON is the open metaparameter (NLAT is edge-closed at 5; the lat axis is passive), and the problem's dlon_deg observed divides by the NLON name, so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. Exact solution sin((pi/180)(lon - omega t)) cos((pi/180) lat) (derivation in the problem file); the recorded errors at t=0.5 are the pure centered-difference phase lag 2 sin(delta/2), delta = omega (pi/180) t (1 - sinc(2 pi/NLON)) — analytically 2.003e-2 / 5.037e-3 / 1.261e-3 / 3.154e-4 over the ladder, an exact O(dlon^2) sequence.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned to match the cartesian problems' convention: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 keeps Python temporal truncation negligible against the spatial goldens (the centered-advection system is non-stiff but neutrally stable, where loose explicit tolerances would add spurious dissipation).
